summary: Iteration 4 — Services/Events admin CRUD + Trips-removed-from-UI regression pass. Backend: 62/62 pytest pass (added 9 new tests: TestServices with 6 tests covering GET /services list (4 seeded), detail, 404, category filter, admin CRUD roundtrip with public list verification, and non-admin 403 for POST/PUT/DELETE; TestEventsAdmin with 2 tests covering admin events CRUD + non-admin 403; TestAdminUnknownEntity for /admin/pizzas -> 404). All prior 49 tests + 4 Host Reply tests still green. IMAGE UPLOAD unchanged and green (TestUploads). Frontend (390x844 mobile web, Arabic RTL, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): (1) Bottom nav shows EXACTLY 4 tabs: tab-map, tab-index, tab-favorites, tab-account — NO tab-trips (hidden via href:null in _layout.tsx as intended). (2) Discover screen shows 4 quick tiles including 'الخدمات' with testID 'quick-services'; tapping navigates to /services which loads 4 real service cards (service-serv_*) each with call button (+967 phone links) and directions button. (3) Map tab renders branded 'اكتشف سقطرى' header with category legend chips + category-grouped destination cards (web fallback, native Google map is device-only — expected). (4) Favorites tab has NO 'رحلات' sub-tab. (5) Search screen for 'socotra' returns only 'المنتجات' section — no trips section. (6) Admin login (admin@socotra.app/Admin@123) -> Account shows 'مدير' badge + menu-admin -> /admin dashboard with 6 stat cards (8 users, 12 destinations, 3 trips [backend still tracks], 8 products, 7 experiences, 20 bookings) -> /admin/content shows 6 tabs: admin-tab-destinations, admin-tab-services (الخدمات), admin-tab-events (الفعاليات), admin-tab-offers, admin-tab-products, admin-tab-experiences and NO admin-tab-trips; admin-add-item button present. No red screens or crashes observed. Only console warnings: shadow* and props.pointerEvents deprecated (pre-existing, non-blocking).

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.
